## Disposition

Accept scoped partial results for equal-pressure foam cells with three audit clarifications. The full global finite-combinatorial-type question, tetrahedral occurrence, dodecahedral occurrence and two-faced continuation remain unresolved after 5/5 approaches. No sixth approach, full solution, global foam construction, novelty certification or exhaustive prior-resolution claim.

The cellwise results retain sufficiently regular finite simple ball cells, disk faces, interval borders, trivalent vertices and finite Gauss–Bonnet terms. The conormal-pair norm is one and each cell edge is counted once in T; the curvature budget is necessary, not a nonexistence theorem. The planar sheet is explicitly truncated and the two catenoid sheets are annuli, not completed minimal disks or a global foam. The all-z ODE identity is expanded. Compact stationarity requires compact support, finite area, no external boundary and minimal interfaces. Finiteness is conditional on an unproved uniform per-cell Q+T bound. N=9 is only an insertion-count threshold, not a realized nine-cell quotient.

## Current mathematics and fresh verification

The complete clarified current report, full authored audit, correction patch, safe checkers and public source metadata are exact copies of the accepted derivative. The full superseded report, copied third-party source bodies, datasets, private sources, private coordination and identifying metadata are excluded. Earlier acceptance and source retrieval/inspection are explicitly historical. Kusner's ResearchGate HTML preview provenance remains unverified; no inspected Kusner PDF is claimed.

Each fresh mode reproduces the unchanged original 56 checks and 7 input-validation controls, plus 227 independent checks including read-only preflight. Sixteen semantic mutants reject at their intended conditions: 10 geometry/algebra mutations and 6 hypothesis/status guards. These finite checks support the written analysis but do not formally prove Gauss–Bonnet, first variation, topology, PDE solvability or global foam realization.

The final fixed external bootstrap authenticates the complete recursive packet, manifest, acceptance and all pre-seal receipts. Normal, -O and -OO runs use actual UID=EUID=1000, files 0444 and directories 0555. Full fresh stdout/stderr is compared with pinned mode-specific references byte-for-byte and with recursive exact JSON types; there is no normalization. Whole-packet before/after hashes agree.

Each mode recorded 56 whole-packet physical EACCES denials and 4 additional mathematical-input denials; 70 integrity negatives, 73 schema/scope negatives and 41 comparator negatives. Full hostile-environment output matched the clean baseline and no hostile startup/import sentinel was created.

Only Python's standard library is required; the installed interpreter and standard-library implementations are trusted, not authenticated by the packet. Unix read-only permissions are an accidental-write barrier, not kernel immutability or protection against intentional owner chmod.

Pre-seal receipts are explicitly labeled and are bound by the final manifest. Final external receipts remain outside the delivered inventory to avoid circular self-hashing. NOT_RUN: full superseded-report replay, historical audit-harness replay, historical correction-patch application, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification.
